messages:
Amy: Quick post-RFC sync: decide admission eval shape. Sync eval (simple) vs local fast-path + async authoritative (complex). Which way?
Ben: Sync first pass. Easier rollback.
Carla: Sync may kill p95 with heavier matchers. Recommend local cache fast-path.
Ed: Two-tier: sidecar returns immediate decision+provenance; control-plane authoritative for billing/complex rules.
Frank: Key problems: cache invalidation across regions, TTL, versioned keys, and stale-while-revalidate semantics.
Gina: DSL note: keep scores bounded and deterministic so sidecars can compare reliably. Example: score = normalize(cost)*1.2 + normalize(latency)*0.8.
policy-bot: REQUIREMENT: responses include policy_version and reason. Use X-Policy-Version header for canaries.
Amy: Action list: (1) define sidecar<->control-plane wire contract; (2) cache key semantics + TTL; (3) runtime versioning story; (4) canary rollout + auto-rollback plan.
Ben: Proto payload suggestion: POST /policy/eval { tenant_id, model, request_hash, region_hints } -> { decision, score, policy_version, reason }
Carla: Keep explainability small: reason <=256 chars + tags array for analytics.
Ed: Include request_fingerprint (sha256) so caches are stable across retries.
Frank: Runtimes should advertise supported policy_version range; unknown versions => fallback heuristic + telemetry event.
Gina: Testing: sim job with 10k synthetic reqs, region churn and model spikes to validate p50/p95 and authority reconciliation.
Amy: Ops: /policy/versions endpoint, 2-week deprecation window for breaking changes, tenant opt-in header for canaries.
Carla: Fallback semantics: if sidecar decision differs from authoritative later, log both and reconcile metrics. Do not retroactively cancel responses.
Ed: Reconciliation: authoritative decision annotates final_decision; sidecar decision remains for latency path.
Frank: Security: sidecars must not leak tenant signals; use mTLS and encrypt policy payloads.
Gina: I'll add perf gates before any canary.
Amy: I'll draft the short RFC addendum and tag owners. Sync Friday 10am.
policy-bot: Task created POLICY-EDGE-789 (owners: Ben,Frank,Carla,Ed,Gina)
All: ack
